docs.text: Blue Blubber Jellyfish are a delight to watch
The Great Lakes have jellyfish! Thankfully, they're tiny and friendly.

You may have heard about the recent sightings of freshwater jellyfish in Lake Erie and wondered (a) is this a bad thing? And (b) what would it take to see one? The answer to the first question is no. As for the second, try taking a boat ride to Put-in-Bay.
